title: MM-NeuroOnco: A Multimodal Benchmark and Instruction Dataset for MRI-Based Brain Tumor Diagnosis

bias_targets.target: Forced-choice bias (Statistical and language prior biases)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multimodal models using a rejection-aware strategy by appending a 'None of the above' option to closed-ended questions and using adversarial distractors, preventing models from achieving artificially high scores by exploiting statistical biases in option distributions or language priors.

primary_bias_target: Forced-choice bias (Statistical and language prior biases)
